subject: MAP: gate crosswalk + retention carveouts (SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ, DPA)
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@crestbank.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@crestbank.com
Date: 2028-09-02T08:13:00-07:00
Subject: MAP intake — gate crosswalk and specific retention carveouts

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are starting to map Redwood into our MAP and need a concise crosswalk for the security gates so our InfoSec and Legal teams can sign off. Specifically we need:

- A SOC 2 controls-to-evidence matrix (which controls have evidence ready, and which require collection).
- SIG/CAIQ mapping for data flows that touch PII and transaction telemetry.
- DPA redline expectations and any retention carveouts (we typically require 7 years for transaction logs; need to confirm if Redwood can tier TTL by dataset).

Can you send a proposed timeline for the MAP lanes (evidence sprint, legal review, final acceptance) and any attachments we should review? Our target close window is end of Q4; if we can timebox the security sprint to a 3-week window, that would work for the CrestBank approvals team.

Best,
Emma Li
Senior Security Program Manager
CrestBank

[attachment: crestbank_evidence_request_20280902.pdf (pdf)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@crestbank.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, legal@crestbank.com
Date: 2028-09-02T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP intake — gate crosswalk and specific retention carveouts

Emma — thanks for the clear ask. Attaching an initial MAP crosswalk and proposed cadence. High level notes up front:

- We split the MAP into three timeboxed lanes: Evidence sprint (2 weeks), Legal/DPA review (1 week), Acceptance and sign-off (1 week). Total recommended MAP runway: 4 weeks (can compress to 3w with parallel work).
- SOC 2: Redwood has an SOC 2 Type II report (scope: production infrastructure, access controls). The crosswalk marks which controls have immediate evidence and which require short-term evidence collection (e.g., endpoint logging samples).
- SIG/CAIQ: We’ve pre-populated CAIQ answers for controls that touch data-in-flight and data-at-rest; items flagged are primarily around telemetry retention and per-tenant log segregation.
- DPA/Retention: Default retention for transaction telemetry is 90 days in hosted; we offer a 7-year archival option via dedicated storage for regulated customers (requires a short config change and updated DPA clause). We’ve noted carveouts and implementation steps in the spreadsheet.

Attachments: redwood_map_crosswalk_v1.xlsx (control matrix + timeline). I’ll loop Marcus for technical evidence collection and Jordan/Naomi for legal/contract pathing.

Next steps I propose:
1) We run the evidence sprint starting Mon 9/11 — Redwood collects samples and map artifacts (2 weeks).
2) CrestBank InfoSec reviews crosswalk during that window and returns gaps.
3) Week of 9/25: Parallel legal redline (DPA v3) and final acceptance call the following week.

If that looks reasonable, I’ll upload the crosswalk to the Drive and send a short intake form for InfoSec to prioritize control areas.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

[attachment: redwood_map_crosswalk_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-02T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Internal — CrestBank MAP: owners & evidence sprint plan (internal)

Team — quick plan to own the incoming sprint for CrestBank (DBL-4391). Short bullets: 

- Marcus: lead evidence collection (SOC 2 artifacts, sample logs for transaction telemetry, KMS key rotation records).
- Naomi: own SIG/CAIQ answers and work with Product to confirm telemetry TTL/segregation.
- Jordan: lead DPA negotiation and confirm whether the 7-year archival clause needs any infrastructure commitments (billing / storage tier).

We will use the Drive folder Kimberly shared. I’ll produce a one-page evidence intake template for InfoSec to mark priority controls — please keep answers concise (artifact links + one-line context). Timeline: start sprint 2028-09-11, wrap evidence by 2028-09-24, legal review 2028-09-25—30.

Please confirm you can hit these windows; Marcus, if we need extra engineer cycles to enable 7-year archival, flag it now.

—Kim

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@crestbank.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, legal@crestbank.com
Date: 2028-09-03T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: MAP crosswalk + proposed sprint dates (SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ, DPA retention carveouts)

Emma — attaching the Drive link and a short MAP schedule per our internal planning. Quick summary of items in the crosswalk (see sheet tabs):

- SOC2_Matrix: shows control id, current artifact status (Available / Needs collection / Partial), and owner (Marcus for infra items).
- CAIQ_Flow: CAIQ answers with notes on telemetry boundaries and which answers are advisory vs. contractual.
- DPA_Retention: shows our default retention tiers and the engineering steps to enable a 7-year archival tier. We noted any potential cost/ops impacts.

Proposed MAP timeline (timeboxed):
- Evidence intake + collection: 2028-09-11 — 2028-09-24 (2w)
- CrestBank review + gap list: by 2028-09-28 (4 business days)
- Legal redline / DPA alignment: 2028-09-25 — 2028-09-30 (overlaps with review)
- Final acceptance call: week of 2028-10-02

If CrestBank needs the sprint compressed to three weeks, we can run evidence collection in parallel with legal redlines, but we’ll ask for explicit priority flags from InfoSec on the top 8 controls so we can scope artifact delivery.

Links/attachments: Drive crosswalk (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cCrosswalkDraft) and a redline draft of the DPA (dpa_redline_v3.docx). I’ll also send a DocuSign envelope for the final DPA once redlines settle.

Thanks — looking forward to your intake priorities.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

[attachment: dpa_redline_v3.docx (document)]

From: Emma Li <emma.li@crestbank.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@crestbank.com
Date: 2028-09-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP crosswalk + proposed sprint dates (SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ, DPA retention carveouts)

Kimberly — this looks good and thanks for the speed. We’ll review the Drive items and get you a prioritized control list by EOD 9/10 so you can start on 9/11. Two quick clarifications before the sprint: 

1) For the 7-year archival option, can you confirm whether the archived data will be logically segregated per customer and whether retrieval is subject to additional egress fees?
2) On SOC 2 evidence: please include last 3 months of change control logs and the most recent pen test scope (even if it’s a summary).

I’ll have Legal take a first pass at the DPA draft as well. If anything changes on our end we’ll flag it early.

Appreciate it —
Emma
Senior Security Program Manager
CrestBank
